// Generated by Pretzel > Data Format > Setup. It is yours to edit; regenerating asks before replacing it.
//
// This sets up DataIO for plain JSON, GZip or BSON files. The format, folder, serializer and backup
// policy come from Assets/Resources/Pretzel/DataIOConfig.asset (Pretzel > Data Format). Change them there,
// or override them in code for this game start without touching the asset:
//
//     ProjectDataIO.Initialize(config => { config.saveFolder = "MyGameSaves"; config.keepBackup = false; });
//
// Call Initialize once from your startup code (Start or later), before any DataIO call. Then use
//
//     DataIO.Save("profile", profile);
//     LoadResult<Profile> result = DataIO.Load<Profile>("profile");   // check result.Status, do not assume Ok
//
// ProjectDataIO.Store is the same store as DataIO.Default, for code that prefers an IDataStore.
using System;
using Pretzel.Data;
using UnityEngine;

public static class ProjectDataIO
{
    // Used only when the DataIOConfig asset is missing. The asset wins when it exists.
    private const DataFormat FallbackFormat = DataFormat.@@FORMAT@@;
    private const string FallbackSaveFolder = "SaveData";

    private static DataIOConfig _config;
    private static DataStore _store;

    public static bool IsReady => _store != null;

    /// <summary>The store behind DataIO.Default. Call Initialize first.</summary>
    public static IDataStore Store => _store ?? throw NotReady();

    /// <summary>The settings in use: a copy of the asset plus your overrides. Change them through Initialize.</summary>
    public static DataIOConfig Config => _config ? _config : throw NotReady();

    [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)]
    private static void ResetForPlaySession() => Shutdown();

    /// <summary>Creates the store once and installs it as DataIO.Default. Calling it again does nothing.</summary>
    /// <param name="configure">Optional overrides applied to a copy of the asset's settings.</param>
    public static void Initialize(Action<DataIOConfig> configure = null)
    {
        if (IsReady)
        {
            if (configure != null)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("ProjectDataIO is already initialized. Call Shutdown first to apply different settings.");
            }

            return;
        }

        DataIOConfig config = CreateConfig(configure);
        DataStore store;
        try
        {
            if (config.format == DataFormat.Encrypted)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("The DataIOConfig is set to Encrypted, but this setup is for plain, GZip or BSON data. "
                    + "Generate the encryption setup on the Setup tab, or choose another format on the Format tab.");
            }

            store = config.CreateStore();
        }
        catch
        {
            Release(config);
            throw;
        }

        _config = config;
        _store = store;
        DataIO.Default = store;
    }

    /// <summary>Forgets the store and resets DataIO. Finish outstanding saves first. Also runs when Play mode starts.</summary>
    public static void Shutdown()
    {
        Release(_config);
        _config = null;
        _store = null;
        DataIO.Reset();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// A second store for other data, such as settings or a cache. It starts from the same settings in its own folder under
    /// the persistent data path, and you can override anything for this store only. Create it once and keep it.
    /// </summary>
    public static DataStore CreateStore(string subFolder, Action<DataIOConfig> configure = null)
    {
        DataIOConfig copy = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(Config);
        try
        {
            configure?.Invoke(copy);
            return copy.CreateStore(DataRoots.PersistentData(subFolder));
        }
        finally
        {
            Release(copy);
        }
    }

    private static DataIOConfig CreateConfig(Action<DataIOConfig> configure)
    {
        DataIOConfig asset = DataIOConfig.Load();
        DataIOConfig config = asset ? UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(asset) : ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<DataIOConfig>();
        if (!asset)
        {
            config.format = FallbackFormat;
            config.fileExtension = DataFormats.DefaultExtension(FallbackFormat);
            config.saveFolder = FallbackSaveFolder;
        }

        try
        {
            configure?.Invoke(config);
        }
        catch
        {
            Release(config);
            throw;
        }

        return config;
    }

    private static void Release(DataIOConfig config)
    {
        if (!config)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (Application.isPlaying)
        {
            UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(config);
        }
        else
        {
            UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(config);
        }
    }

    private static InvalidOperationException NotReady()
    {
        return new InvalidOperationException("Call ProjectDataIO.Initialize() from your startup code before using DataIO.");
    }
}
